title: Online Boutique / Frontend release impact
description: Before/after view of a frontend release: user-facing latency and errors, backend fan-out, resource saturation and application logs. Built from Linkerd proxy metrics in VictoriaMetrics and pod logs in VictoriaLogs.

list.name: Frontend rollout
list.expr: count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace",container="server",pod=~"$frontend-.*"}) unless count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace",container="server",pod=~"$frontend-.*"} offset 1m)

target.expr: count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace",container="server",pod=~"$frontend-.*"}) unless count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace",container="server",pod=~"$frontend-.*"} offset 1m)

panels.title: Frontend image running
panels.description: Image of the frontend `server` container in Running pods right now (kube-state-metrics, registry path stripped). Two values during a rollout.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Share of frontend responses Linkerd classifies as success (non-5xx).

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of frontend response time, measured by the inbound Linkerd proxy.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second reaching the frontend (load generator + probes).

panels.title: Catalog RPCs/req
panels.description: productcatalogservice calls the frontend makes per inbound request. The stock frontend needs ~4. A jump here is backend fan-out (N+1) in the frontend.

panels.title: Frontend image over time
panels.description: One lane per image seen in Running frontend pods. Annotations mark rollouts.

panels.title: User-facing: frontend as seen by its inbound proxy
p95 latency by route
panels.description: Per-route percentiles from the frontend ServiceProfile (manifests/online-boutique/serviceprofiles.yaml). Health checks and static assets hidden.

panels.title: Blast radius: what the frontend does to the backends
Frontend outbound RPCs by destination
panels.description: Every gRPC call the frontend makes, grouped by backend. Compare with the inbound request rate.

panels.title: productcatalogservice calls by method
panels.description: From the productcatalogservice ServiceProfile. GetProduct climbing while ListProducts stays flat is the signature of per-item lookups.

panels.title: Catalog RPCs per frontend request
panels.description: Fan-out ratio over time. Stock frontend: ~4.

panels.title: productcatalogservice latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Server-side latency of the catalog. Rises when the service is CPU-starved by the extra calls.

panels.title: Frontend outbound failures by destination
panels.description: Backend calls that failed (gRPC non-OK / 5xx / timeouts).

panels.title: CPU usage vs limit (cores)
panels.description: Flat-topped usage against the dashed limit means CFS throttling: the container wants more CPU than allowed.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: OOMKilled / liveness-probe restarts show up here.

panels.title: Frontend log volume by severity (debug excluded)
panels.description: Log lines per interval, by logrus severity. Debug lines (one per request) are left out so info/warning/error stay readable.

panels.title: Request time by path (from frontend request logs)
panels.description: The frontend logs every completed request with http.resp.took_ms. Independent of the mesh: same story, seen from inside the process.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="$namespace",kubernetes.pod_labels.app="$frontend",kubernetes.container_name="server"} _msg:"request complete" | replace_regexp ("^/product/[^/]+$", "/product/{id}") at log.http.req.path | replace_regexp ("^/static/.*$", "/static/*") at log.http.req.path | stats by (log.http.req.path) count() as requests, quantile(0.5, log.http.resp.took_ms) as p50_ms, quantile(0.95, log.http.resp.took_ms) as p95_ms, max(log.http.resp.took_ms) as max_ms

{kubernetes.pod_namespace="$namespace",kubernetes.pod_labels.app="$frontend",kubernetes.container_name="server"} log.severity:in(warning, error, fatal, panic) | format "[<log.severity>] <log.http.req.method> <log.http.req.path> - <_msg> <log.error>" as _msg
